summary: No installer-harm behavior identified in tailwind-anim@1.1.1
details: The package contents do not exhibit exfiltration, install-time code fetch/execute, silent-relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or self-propagation behavior. No lifecycle hooks executing external content, no reads of installer secrets (env vars, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), and no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations were observed.
